content.title: When Dog Grooming at Home Makes Sense
content.body: This page is built for dog owners who want a practical, reassuring grooming appointment without salon travel, long waiting times, or extra stress for their pet.

items.title: Routine Coat Care
items.body: Regular grooming keeps your dog's coat cleaner, easier to manage, and more comfortable between visits.

items.title: Dogs Who Dislike Travel
items.body: A mobile appointment helps dogs avoid car rides, crowded salons, and unfamiliar waiting areas.

items.title: Busy Dubai Households
items.body: The groomer comes to your location, so you can plan the service around your day.

items.title: Every 4-6 Weeks
items.body: Most dogs benefit from a regular coat, nail, and hygiene routine.

items.title: Before Guests or Travel
items.body: Book ahead of holidays, visitors, boarding, or photo-ready family moments.

items.title: When Coat Issues Start
items.body: Dematting, deshedding, ticks, and hygiene trims are easier to handle before they become uncomfortable.

items.title: Clear Package Choice
items.body: Choose basic or full grooming based on your dog's size and coat needs.

items.title: Helpful Add-Ons
items.body: Add targeted services such as deshedding, teeth brushing, medicated bath, or ear cleaning.

items.title: Simple Aftercare
items.body: Your groomer can share practical next steps for coat, nail, and hygiene maintenance.

content.title: Which Dog Grooming Package Should You Choose?
content.body: Choose by size first, then decide whether your dog needs a simple refresh or a more complete grooming appointment.

items.title: Best for maintenance
items.body: Choose Basic Grooming when your dog needs a routine refresh, bath, and tidy hygiene support.

items.title: Good for regular visits
items.body: A practical choice for dogs who stay on a consistent grooming schedule.

items.title: Best for a deeper tidy-up
items.body: Choose Full Grooming when your dog needs a more complete coat and hygiene session.

items.title: Useful before events
items.body: A stronger option before travel, guests, photos, or when your dog needs extra attention.

items.title: Target specific needs
items.body: Use add-ons for dematting, ticks, deshedding, teeth brushing, ear cleaning, nails, and hygiene trims.

items.title: Confirm before booking

items.question: How do I know whether to choose Basic or Full Grooming?
items.answer: Basic Grooming is best for regular maintenance. Full Grooming is better when your dog needs a more complete tidy-up or extra coat and hygiene attention.

items.question: How is the price decided?
items.answer: Dog package prices are based on size: small dogs are less than 9kg, medium dogs are 10kg - 19kg, and large dogs are above 20kg.

items.question: Can I add extra services to my booking?
items.answer: Yes. Add-ons include dematting, tick removal, flea and ticks bath, deshedding, medicated bath, teeth brushing, eye cleaning and trimming, hygiene trim, nail clipping, and ear cleaning.

items.question: Where can the grooming appointment happen?
items.answer: SMS Pet Grooming can come to your home, hotel, or office in Dubai, depending on availability and appointment confirmation.
